inputs.name: sourceRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root of Japanese Markdown source files.

inputs.name: outputRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root for mirrored Vietnamese Markdown translations and JSON caches.

inputs.name: glossary
inputs.description: Markdown file containing project terminology and translation rules.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Repository-relative globs of source documents to leave out of translation and cache checks.

inputs.name: syncBase
inputs.description: Base branch that receives the merged sync pull request and generated translation pull requests.

inputs.name: sourceBranch
inputs.description: Head branch whose merged pull request into syncBase starts translation.

inputs.name: gateBases
inputs.description: Pull request base branches on which translation caches must remain synchronized.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used by translation and cache-synchronization skills.

inputs.name: maxFilesPerGroup
inputs.description: Maximum source files in a group and maximum concurrent translations for that group.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Time limit in minutes for each document's translation or cache sync, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum Claude turns for each document's translation or cache sync, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxBudgetUsd
inputs.description: Runaway guard in USD (API list price) for each document's translation or cache sync, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxRepairs
inputs.description: Same-session model repair attempts after a translated document fails checkOutputs; zero keeps the verify-only gate.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.description: Claude tools of the translate step; replaces the whole default list. Keep Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, and Bash(jq empty:*); add only narrow Bash(<command>:*) rules.

inputs.name: syncCacheAllowedTools
inputs.description: Claude tools of the cache-sync step; replaces the whole default list. Keep Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, and Bash(jq empty:*); add only narrow Bash(<command>:*) rules.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Complete replacement for the default translation, cache-sync, output-check, and drift-check tools.
